title: Transformed our AP department
comment: We process 3,000+ invoices monthly across 180 properties. Invoice Processing handles 97% without human intervention. Our AP team went from data entry to exception management — it's a completely different role now.

title: Prospects love the interactive maps
comment: Our website conversion rate increased 18% after adding Engrain maps. Prospects spend significantly more time exploring availability, and the real-time pricing overlay from Entrata means they always see accurate information.

title: Strong results, still fine-tuning
comment: Collections improved 12% in the first 90 days. We're still dialing in the escalation thresholds for different property types, but the platform is very configurable. The compliance logging gives our legal team peace of mind.

title: Zero cost, real results
comment: Flex is a no-brainer. It costs us nothing, residents love the flexibility, and our late payments dropped 28%. The fact that Flex guarantees our full payment on the 1st regardless — that's the game changer.

title: Complex migration, flawless execution
comment: We migrated 18,000 units from a legacy MRI setup with 12 years of historical data. The Pro Services team handled every complication professionally. Data accuracy was 99.8% — better than we expected for a migration this complex.

title: Delinquency down, relationships intact
comment: The tone is remarkable — residents actually thank the AI for being helpful. Our 30-day delinquency dropped from 5.8% to 2.9% in the first quarter. The payment plan feature is brilliant.

title: ROI in the first month
comment: The GL coding accuracy was better than our team by month two. We eliminated 1.5 FTEs of manual invoice work and the payback was under 30 days. The duplicate detection alone has saved us from three significant overpayments.

title: Catches fraud we would have missed
comment: In our first month, Snappt flagged 8 applications with altered bank statements — two of which had already passed our manual review. At $12,000+ per fraudulent lease, the math is obvious.

title: Residents love it, easy to manage
comment: Enrollment was seamless through the Homebody app. Residents are genuinely excited about the credit building benefit. The 29-point average improvement we're seeing matches the marketing claims.

title: Self-resolution is the hidden gem
comment: The diagnostic conversation resolves 20% of requests without a tech visit — garbage disposal resets, thermostat issues, breaker trips. That's 200 fewer work orders per month for us. Residents appreciate the instant help.

title: Best retention tool in our stack
comment: Rent Reporting is our secret weapon for renewals. Residents see their credit score climbing and they don't want to leave. Our renewal rate at Rent Reporting properties is 6 points higher than non-enrolled communities.

title: Every renewal offer sent on time, every time
comment: Before ELI+ Renewals, we'd lose 10-15 renewals per quarter just from late outreach. Now every resident gets a personalized offer at exactly the right time. Our renewal rate jumped 5 points in the first 6 months.

title: Game changer for lease-ups
comment: We deployed ELI+ Leasing on a 400-unit new development. It handled the flood of initial inquiries that would have required 3 temporary leasing agents. We hit 90% occupied 6 weeks ahead of schedule.

title: Finally, clean property data in our warehouse
comment: The pre-built data models saved us months of modeling work. We had Entrata data flowing into our Snowflake instance within a week, and the 15-minute refresh means our dashboards are always current.

title: Our best leasing agent never sleeps
comment: ELI+ handles 65% of our prospect conversations end-to-end. The response time went from hours to seconds, and our tour scheduling rate increased 22%. The after-hours lead capture alone justified the investment.
